text:
Ari: Heads-up thread for the benchmark narrative. We need a compact deck we can use in the webinar and as a 1-pager for inbound leads. Focus: latency SLOs vs unit cost tradeoffs across our hosting modes.

Nora: Agreed. Core structure proposal: 1) Hero claim + one-liner summary; 2) Latency distribution mini-panel (median/p95/p99) across models and deployment modes; 3) Unit-cost waterfall + two optimization knobs (batching, quantization); 4) 'What this means' slide mapping to product choices (Hosted, Dedicated, Private); 5) CTA + lead path.

Devon: Data requests: Please include the following slices in the CSV: model name, deployment_mode, quantization, seq_len_bucket, median_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, tokens_per_sec, cost_per_1k_usd, cache_hit_rate. We'll run sim for prompt mix: 60% short, 30% medium, 10% long.

Sam: Visual direction: use a horizontal violin for latency comparison (compact), a waterfall for unit cost with color-coded optimization layers, and a small table for recommended configs by persona (Startup, Scale, Regulated). Keep copy micro: 8-12 words per caption.

Ari: Timeline: Nora hero + 3 alt lines by EOD Fri. Devon provide CSV + sample JSON by Fri 2pm. Sam mockups Fri EOD. I'll assemble on Mon and share for review Tues.

Devon: Will populate s3://bench-exports/2026/marketing/bench-narrative-4976543210.csv by Fri 13:30 UTC. ChartBot validates schema.

ChartBot: Schema check: required headers = [model, deployment_mode, quantization, seq_len_bucket, median_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, tokens_per_sec, cost_per_1k_usd, cache_hit_rate]. No issues found in preview.

Nora: Hero drafts (short):
- H1: "SLAs you can promise. Costs you can forecast."
- H2: "Fastest median. Tamer tail. Lower $/token."
- H3: "Configure latency. Cut unit costs."

Sam: I like H1 for enterprise-facing slides; H3 for quick social. Suggest H2 as subtitle.

Devon: Quick reproducibility snippet for cost calc we'll include in notes:
```
# cost per 1k tokens (approx)
seq = 1000
sec_per_1k = 0.9
gpu_hours = sec_per_1k / 3600
gpu_rate = 3.0  # $/gpu-hour for dedicated pool
unit_cost = gpu_hours * gpu_rate / 1.0  # divide by any concurrency factor if present
print(unit_cost)
```

Ari: Also add a mini-case: "How switching to dedicated with aggressive batching saved X% vs hosted on same workload" using a real customer anonymized. Nora, can you draft the one-paragraph case?

Nora: On it. I'll anonymize and keep to two metrics: latency p95 and $/1k tokens.

Sam: For the 1-pager CTA, propose two lead routes: 1) 'Self-serve benchmark' -> start free trial + import prompts; 2) 'Hands-on eval' -> request Dedicated trial. Short lines: "Run your prompts. See your numbers." and "Talk to solutions: dedicated sizing & pricing."

Ari: Great. Let's avoid heavy technical jargon on the public slide; keep a deeper appendix with kernel/quant details.

Devon: Uploaded CSV & sample prompt set to internal preview: https://internal.redwood/bench/preview/4976543210

ChartBot: Upload timestamp 2026-03-22T14:20:00Z. Automated note: mean cache_hit_rate for sample = 0.42.

Nora: Drafts live at drive/marketing/bench-4976543210/hero-and-onepager.md — drop edits there.

Ari: Closing. We'll reconvene Mon AM if any gaps. Thanks team. :rocket:
